title: You've Got to be Efficient: Ambiguity, Misspecification and Variational Preferences
abstract: arXiv:2604.05327v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This article introduces a framework for evaluating statistical decisions under both prior ambiguity and likelihood misspecification. We begin with an ambiguity set - a frequentist model that pairs a possibly misspecified likelihood with every possible prior - and uniformly expand it by a Kullback-Leibler radius to accommodate likelihood misspecification. We show that optimal decisions under this framework are equivalent to minimax decisions with an exponentially tilted loss function. Misspecification manifests as an exponential tilting of the loss, while ambiguity corresponds to a search for the least favorable prior. This separation between ambiguity and misspecification enables local asymptotic analysis under global misspecification, achieved by localizing the priors alone. translated_title: 你必须高效：模糊性、错误设定与变分偏好
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.05327v5 公告类型：替换 摘要：本文介绍了一个在先验模糊性和似然错误设定下评估统计决策的框架。我们从模糊集开始——一个频率论模型，将可能错误设定的似然与每个可能的先验配对——并通过Kullback-Leibler半径统一扩展该集合，以容纳似然错误设定。我们表明，在此框架下的最优决策等价于具有指数倾斜损失函数的极小极大决策。错误设定表现为损失的指数倾斜，而模糊性则对应于寻找最不利的先验。这种模糊性与错误设定之间的分离，使得在全局错误设定下进行局部渐近分析成为可能，只需对先验进行局部化。值得注意的是，对于估计和治疗分配，我们表明最优决策与正确设定下的决策一致，无论错误程度如何。
tldr: 本文提出一个统一框架，将先验模糊性和似然错误设定分离处理，证明最优决策在错误设定下仍与正确设定一致，并实现全局错误下的局部渐近分析。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified framework separating prior ambiguity from likelihood misspecification, showing optimal decisions remain consistent with correct specification under misspecification, enabling local asymptotic analysis under global errors.
